text.en: Sits on a 56 m concrete tower on Praha, the second-highest summit of the Brdy hills southwest of Prague. With a range of about 260 km it covers all of Bohemia. The tower dates from 1999 to 2000; the current dual-polarisation radar was installed in 2015.

Stands on a 37 m concrete tower on Skalky, the highest point of the Drahany Highlands near Protivanov in central Moravia. It covers all of Moravia. The tower was built in 1995; the current dual-polarisation radar replaced the original one in 2015.
